data.name: Emotion Hunter
data.detailed_description:
Game contents:

This game is a 2D anime-style side-scrolling  melee action game.

The game features a stage-based system with multiple difficulty levels to choose from. It also incorporates a visual novel system, allowing players to experience the narrative as they progress through the levels.


Game Lore / Worldview:

The heroine gains the ability to enter people’s unconscious minds through a stuffed doll that has been by her side since childhood, allowing them to hunt down negative emotions within the strange world.

In this world, she encounters another young girl who possesses the exact same ability.The encounter between these two girls and the choices made by the player will lead to various endings.

 

Key Features:

  • Anime-Style 2D Action Platformer: Embark on an adventure through the subconscious mind, featuring cute anime-style characters and monsters born from volatile emotions.

  • Dual Protagonist System: Seamlessly switch between two girls with mind-diving abilities, each boasting unique combat styles and distinct skill sets.

  • Precision Controls: Master a fluid control system featuring attacks, jumps, dodges, and dashes to cut down every enemy in your path with swords and blades.

  • Accessible yet Lethal Difficulty: Tailor your experience with selectable difficulty levels. Clear the Hard mode to unlock uncapped difficulties and push your limits against even stronger foes.

  • Classic Japanese AVG Elements: Dive into a rich, immersive narrative between battles, allowing you to uncover the secrets of this fantasy world.

  • Branching Storylines: With a narrative driven by your choices, every decision you make in this visual novel-style experience will alter the path and lead to different fates.

Language Support: Chinese, Japanese, English.

 

Steam Release Timeline

The full version of the game is projected to officially launch on Steam between late 2027 and early 2028.

data.short_description: A 2D hand-crafted anime-style side-scrolling melee action game. Dive into the mysterious unconscious minds to hunt down negative emotion monsters! Master precise combat mechanics, challenge multiple difficulties, and find your perfect combat rhythm.
data.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese
